**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Meetings
- **Clearer audio menu.** The meeting bar's menu now reads "Automatic (detects headset)", "With headset: microphone + Mac sound" and "Without headset: microphone only". The status pill matches ("Headset · microphone + Mac sound", "No headset · microphone only"). Routing is unchanged and your saved choice carries over.
- **No more Glossary lines during silence with GPT Transcribe, xAI or your own server.** A quiet stretch answered with nothing but your Glossary terms is now dropped as "no speech", as it already was with Gemini.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.67...v8.68
